turns.text: create me a simple tic tac toe game

Built a complete Tic Tac Toe game with a clean, modern UI. The game features a 3x3 grid, player turn indicator, win/draw detection with highlighted winning lines, score tracking persisted in localStorage, and a reset button. Fully accessible with keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, and visible focus states. Includes Playwright tests covering gameplay, win detection, score persistence, and console error checks.
